title: Sleepy ladybug
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sleepy ladybug, top-down cute view -->
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='14' y='38' width='12' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#ff9a3c'/>
  <rect x='14' y='56' width='12' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#ff9a3c'/>
  <rect x='74' y='38' width='12' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#ff9a3c'/>
  <rect x='74' y='56' width='12' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#ff9a3c'/>
  <rect x='18' y='24' width='10' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#ff9a3c'/>
  <rect x='72' y='24' width='10' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#ff9a3c'/>
  <rect x='18' y='70' width='10' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#ff9a3c'/>
  <rect x='72' y='70' width='10' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#ff9a3c'/>
  <!-- body shell -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='32' ry='30' fill='#e63946'/>
  <!-- shell highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='42' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#ff6b78'/>
  <!-- wing split line -->
  <rect x='48' y='26' width='4' height='56' rx='2' fill='#5c1020'/>
  <!-- spots -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='44' r='5' fill='#5c1020'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='44' r='5' fill='#5c1020'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='62' r='4.5' fill='#5c1020'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='62' r='4.5' fill='#5c1020'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='72' r='3.5' fill='#5c1020'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='72' r='3.5' fill='#5c1020'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='24' rx='17' ry='13' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
  <!-- head shine -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='19' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#6a6a88'/>
  <!-- sleepy closed eyes -->
  <path d='M38 24 Q42 29 46 24' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 24 Q58 29 62 24' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little smile -->
  <path d='M46 31 Q50 34 54 31' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- zzz -->
  <path d='M76 14 h6 l-6 6 h6' stroke='#9fd0ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M84 6 h4 l-4 4 h4' stroke='#9fd0ff' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
</svg>
